known_source_limitations: Page 2 lists AVR CPU up to 16 MHz; page 7 says the main processor runs up to 20 MHz. Do not silently resolve this contradiction using outside knowledge.
Page 5 lists maximum power consumption as xx mA, not a usable numeric specification.
Diagrams are not interpreted: only extractable text is indexed.
This is a software retrieval demonstration, not hardware design approval.
